requirements.requirement: The system must return a clinical trial search response from the facade layer that includes a 'phase' field for each trial.
The system must return a 'phase_score' field for each clinical trial in the facade response.
The system must ensure the 'phase_score' value in the response matches the deterministic mapping defined in the phase scoring logic.
The system must propagate both 'phase' and 'phase_score' fields through the evaluate_care_facade without omission.
The system must return a list of trials where every item includes both 'phase' and 'phase_score' fields when valid phase data exists.
The system must preserve the original phase value (e.g., I, II, III, IV) exactly as received from the upstream service in the response.
The system must ensure the 'phase_score' field is a numeric value within the normalized range defined by the schema.
The system must successfully return a response with 'phase' and 'phase_score' fields when invoked through the full facade API endpoint under normal conditions.
The system must include 'phase_score' for all trials where 'phase' is one of the supported values (I, II, III, IV).
The system must return a null or default 'phase_score' value when the 'phase' field is missing or marked as N/A.
The system must not throw an error when a clinical trial has an unexpected or unsupported phase value and must still return a valid response.
The system must ensure the API response structure remains valid and parseable JSON when 'phase' or 'phase_score' fields are absent or null.
